summary:
All 4 user requirements for the Spare Parts Price Quiz & Inventory Suite have been implemented:
1. Catalog Currency Formulas: Manual Yuan exchange rate input with dynamic recalculations across the entire product catalog, keeping Dirham automatic at 3.67 AED.
2. Quiz System: Full quiz mode support (Multiple Choice, Type Price, True/False, Any Quiz Mode) for Price D / USD + / Sale; selectable question counts (10, 20, 30, 100, and Custom); non-deterministic Fisher-Yates random ordering from anywhere in the database; selectable speed timers (20s, 25s, 30s, Off); real-time progress indicator and explicit Next Question button.
3. Price Tracker Simplification: Strictly 3 clean sections (New Products, Price Increase, Price Decrease) displaying Product name, Previous price, New price, Price difference, and Date of change.
4. Register Company & Product History: Full company profile registration with WhatsApp; supplier-product assignment; "View Products" drilldown with filters for Brand, Model, Part Type, and Purchase Date; professional PDF export and direct print.
